panels.description: Iso-Loss Contours and Technical Substitution on (N, Q) Plane with Downsizing Vectors
panels.x_axis: Model Parameter Scale N (Billion Params, Log Scale)
panels.observation: Improving Q by +0.1 allows 8.3% (0.16B), 14.9% (1.04B), and 25.9% (6.86B) parameter savings

panels.description: Equivalent Required Parameter Gain Delta N_gain vs Initial Scale N across D=10B and D=300B Regimes
panels.x_axis: Current Model Scale N (Billion Params, Log Scale)
panels.y_axis: Equivalent Required Param Gain Delta N_gain (B, Log Scale)
panels.observation: Critical singularity N_crit exists where reducible term A*N^(-alpha) <= Delta L_Q (N_crit=297B for D=10B, N_crit=4,879B for D=300B); beyond N_crit, quality gap cannot be compensated by any finite parameters
